title: Come Here Villager!
description: Tired of yelling "come here!" when kidnapping villagers? Hand them an emerald and they'll willingly follow you instead!
body:
**Come Here Villager!** makes transporting villagers simple, intuitive, and far less frustrating!

Tired of wrestling villagers into boats, pushing them through minecart networks, or trying to convince them to walk where you want? This mod adds a lightweight recruitment system that lets you bring villagers along with you wherever your adventures take you.

Simply sneak and right click a villager while holding an emerald to recruit them.
Once recruited, the villager will faithfully follow you, making it easy to relocate them to a new base, transport them to trading halls, move them between villages, or simply keep them close while traveling.

When you've reached your destination, you can dismiss them just as easily and let them continue their normal villager life.

### Features
- Recruit villagers using an emerald
- Recruited villagers follow their recruiter
- Easy transportation without boats or minecarts
- Perfect for moving villagers to trading halls or new settlements
- Simple and intuitive controls
- Lightweight and multiplayer-friendly
- No complicated GUIs, commands, or configuration required
